lineStatuses.reason: WINDRUSH LINE: Monday 3, Tuesday 4, Wednesday 5 and Thursday 6 August, after 2330 each evening, no service between New Cross Gate and West Croydon / Crystal Palace. The bus for East Croydon will depart London Bridge at 0035 calling at New Cross Gate, Brockley, Honor Oak Park, Forest Hill, Sydenham, Norwood Junction and East Croydon. One return bus from Crystal Palace departs at 2359, calling at all stations to London Bridge via New Cross Gate. Alternatively, use local buses or trams via any reasonable route. The 2232 and 2247 Highbury & Islington to West Croydon trains are diverted to Crystal Palace. The 2338 Dalston Junction to New Cross Gate train does not run.
